heroHeadline: Brussels Confirms WWF Complaint Tangled in Cernavodă Restart Saga as Wildfire Growth Slows
heroSubtitle: The European Commission confirmed on 28 August that WWF Central and Eastern Europe filed a 2024 complaint over Danube works on the Bala branch designed to secure Cernavodă's cooling water — a dispute former Transport Minister Sorin Grindeanu blames for leaving both reactors offline into autumn, a framing WWF calls unfounded. EFFIS put the EU's cumulative 2026 wildfire total at 658,327 hectares as of 10 September, growing just 816 hectares in a day as fire danger eased broadly, though extreme conditions persist across Iberia, France, the western Balkans and southern Italy. No new wildfire outbreaks, fatalities or evacuations have been confirmed across Spain, France, Italy, Portugal, Greece or Romania since early September.
